items.q: Is converting Excel to PDF free?
items.a: Yes, converting Excel to PDF is free within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: Will my sheet's formatting be preserved?
items.a: Yes — column widths, cell formatting, and print layout convert well for most spreadsheets. Very wide sheets may split across multiple PDF pages, matching how the sheet would print.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
